parameters.query:
-- Buscar clientes para newsletter semanal
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.nome,
  c.email,
  c.tipo_interesse,
  c.localizacao_preferida,
  c.valor_maximo,
  c.score_qualificacao
FROM clientes c
WHERE c.status = 'ativo'
  AND c.email IS NOT NULL
  AND c.email != ''
  AND c.email NOT LIKE '%@test%'
  AND c.email NOT LIKE '%@example%'
ORDER BY c.score_qualificacao DESC, c.ultima_interacao DESC
LIMIT 200;

-- Buscar imóveis em destaque para newsletter
SELECT 
  i.id,
  i.codigo_interno,
  i.tipo,
  i.endereco,
  i.bairro,
  i.cidade,
  i.valor,
  i.quartos,
  i.banheiros,
  i.area_construida,
  i.fotos_urls[1] as foto_principal
FROM imoveis i
WHERE i.status = 'disponivel'
  AND i.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY i.visualizacoes DESC, i.created_at DESC
LIMIT 6;
